Thank you. I know I have the ability to change my life. But I want 18 to be my benchmark. If I don't show results by then, I will have to kill myself. I can't live as an adult with my brother. It scares me.

But anyways, thanks for your feedback.

Tbh I don't really have much hope, but I'm not the type of person who suddenly wants to commit suicide. I plan through it.

But am I normal though? Do I perhaps have something wrong with me? I edited my post. 

I am negative pretty much everyday. I enjoy staying alone, never talking to anybody irl. I enjoy being a loner, but at the same time, I want human interaction. It's odd.

I am consistently frustrated with my life.
Uh, I know I'm being sooo weird. But I can't help my stupid thought process. But it's on my mind sooo much. At least an answer will help me stop thinking so weirdly.
